text: I know you are the black knight!\nReveal yourself now!!
What are you talkin' about?!\nI'm not a black knight!!
Ugg...! You've been attacking Straye adventurers\nlike this?!
That's right. I've been wanting to fight the black\nknights that belong to the Black Corps of the\nsouthern Empire.
But I never get the chance to see them...\nHowever, I heard the rumors about a black knight\nshowing up at many places recently.
There've been many anecdotes about them defeating\nvarious powerful monsters and skillful soldiers...
I can gain fame for sure if I beat them...!\nThat's why I'm looking for them like this!!
There's nothing to do with Straye adventurers,\nis there?!
Don't you understand?! Nobody knows when and\nwhere black knights appear. That means they're\nin disguise!
That's why I targeted Straye adventurers and\nwarriors who use axes!
The black knights help the weak and take down\nevil monsters and people.\nHow dare you beat him?!
Heh! I don't care. I just wanna beat strong\nsoldiers and prove my strength! I wanna be\nrecognized as the strongest warrior in the world!!
You... You hurt many people for that reason...?\nI'm never gonna forgive you!!
The face behind the mask looks familiar...\nIt turned out to be Ruzart who tried to snatch\nthe gem in spite of Cipiwon's warning!
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
